profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GameChanger
profile.summary:
Very passionate and enthusiast programmer with 18 years of experience developing and designing web applications. Quick learner, self-motivated, hard worker, proven ability to organize and prioritize tasks, great team player.

Repositories:
https://github.com/odiel
https://github.com/jswf

Experience:
·      Eighteen years breathing web applications concept, design and development
·      Great knowledge in relational database modeling
·      Proven ability to plan, organize, give priority to many tasks and meet deadlines
·      Excellent analytical skills, self motivated, quick learner and hard team worker

Technologies:
PHP, SYMFONY, PhalconPHP, Java, RabbitMQ, Beanstalk, Web Services, JSON Validation, PHP UnitTest, HTML, CSS, Javascript, AJAX, REST APIS, WEB APIS, MySQL, OrientDB, ElasticSearch, Git, Redis, WebRTC, HTML5, JQuery, AngularJS, Knockout, React, Bootstrap, CSS3, Linux, Mercurial, GO Lang, Zephir, SQL Server, Postgres, Mongo, C#, BlitzMax(Advanced), Monkey(Advanced)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Design, develop and maintain a scalable system to store events|logs from different applications and websites across the company with support for custom alerts and reports based on the collected data.  (PHP5, Symfony, OrientDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Web Services, REST, JSON validation, UnitTest)
- Design, develop and maintain a scalable file storage service to handle all uploads coming from most of the company websites; supporting huge file uploads, chunked uploads and url upload.  (PHP5, Symfony, OrientDB, RabbitMQ, Web Services, REST, JSON validation, UnitTest)
- Design, develop and maintain a centralized solution platform to manage videos processing and encoding. (PHP5, Symfony, Doctrine, Mysql, web services, serialized JSON classes, Aria2, Beanstalk, UnitTest, Integration Tests)
- Write and maintain different PHP libraries for the current services. (JSON Serializer, Curl client, Services SDK, File Handling, UnitTest, Integration Tests)
- Write down documentation related to the some services, design workflows to provide the client with a better understanding when using the services (Confluence, Gliffy)

positions.title: Senior Web Programmer
positions.description:
- Re-factor code, fix issues and add new features allowing the sites to increase performance
- Create a custom system to track user activity, providing with a better understand about the customers preferences
-  Re factor code to add multi-language support increased the impact and acceptance of the sites opening the market by a 40%
- Design and maintain an internal solution  to manage the company business logic 
   -  A variety of statistic reports allowed  the company to get better design user interface  increasing customers registrations by 20%
   -  A variety of sales reports gave a detailed view of sales by country and language allowing the company to focus more in specific markets 
   -  A personalized customer service system improved the customer happiness, avoiding many charge backs. 
   -  A custom affiliates management tools provided the ability to manage affiliates subscription, pixels codes and affiliates statistics.
   -  A set of tools to handle sites configuration and behaviors provided with a real time impact in the customers experience and the % of sales

- Develop and maintain a small search engine solution, http://www.searchbrowsing.com, allows the company to obtain revenues  through general ads and customized ads products based on customers search
- Develop and maintain an application to replace an existing PHP router using GO Language, to  increase servers performance. Based on several rules the router decides to which product send the customer
- Develop and maintain a custom solution for Continuous Integration and Deployment allows to put changes live in short time also allows to roll back changes very quick, avoiding errors and sales decrease
   - Develop and maintain CI and Deployment script for every site. (Scripts were written in Phing)
- Design and develop a Full REST API to perform banking operations with 3rd gateways APIs. A centralized system to handle every gateway operation and provide an easy interface to our sites.

positions.title: PHP Senior Developer
positions.description:
-   	Fix various minor stuffs on public site (www.beyondtherack.com)
-   	Work with email templates for customers subscription system (http://www.beyondtherack.com)
-   	Refactoring of Refund process.
-   	Create a set of modules for ERP site to automate and manage Item Fulfillment documents generation and print. (PDF Generation, creation of a set of classes to perform REST operations against NetSuite, complex logic to combine multiples documents in one, refund combined documents and notify the final customer, create a set of php crons to perform multiples operations, create smart print scripts for load balance and  distribution to print documents for CUPS (printer server), system to schedule print runs,  advanced log system to handle errors and create future reports in easy way, create views/reports getting information from DB using AJAX).

positions.title: Programmer and designer of intranet services.
positions.description:
-	Develop an intranet to increase company workflow (HTML, CSS, JS, JQuery, AJAX, PHP5, Zend Framework, JSON, XML) 
-	Intranet relational database modeling (Mysql)

positions.title: Videogames developer
positions.description:
- Team manager
- 2d video game programmer using Blitzmax
- Framework programmer using Blitzmax
